about: Hand-curated inputs for etl/fetch/north_america/canada_treaties.py; nothing here can be derived by script. cirnac_dates: signing and adhesion dates read (by a person) from the CIRNAC Treaty Texts pages named in cirnac_pages (fetched to raw/canada_treaties/cirnac_pages/<name>.html, URLs in fetch.CIRNAC_PAGES); the texts give dates in prose, often spelled out, recited in later deeds or in editorial brackets, so they are transcribed rather than parsed. signatories: parties as named in the treaty preamble/title on those pages (federal) or an override of the Morris 1943 label (Ontario); omitted -> parsed from the Morris label. not_on_page: dates deliberately not from a cited page (skipped by the page check). comment: for people only. note: appended to the feature note. drop: feature left out, with the reason (federal and Ontario layers overlap). merges: features with identical geometry combined into one. Keys: ON-<Ontario LIO TREATY_ID>, CA-<CIRNAC TAG_ID>.

ON-007.comment: No. 3 indenture 7 Dec 1792 recites 22 May 1784 indenture

ON-010.signatories: Mississauga (Brant Tract text: 'Sachems and Chiefs warriors and principal women of the said Mississague nation'); Morris: 'The Crown to Joseph Brant'

ON-023.note: LIO DATE_E (1833-08-13) duplicates Treaty 35's date and conflicts with the CIRNAC deed (1827-07-10) and Morris (No. 27 1/2, 1825-04-25)

ON-025.note: 1836 Treaty 45: Crown sought Manitoulin as a refuge for all Indians; 1862 Treaty 94 surrendered most of the island (Wiikwemkoong unceded)

ON-033.drop: Treaty 3 Ontario part only; federal HT09 (whole treaty incl. Manitoba) used

ON-034.drop: Treaty 5 Ontario part only; federal PT0011a (whole treaty incl. 1908-10 adhesion area) used

ON-036.signatories: Chippewas (31 Oct 1923); Mississagas (15 Nov 1923) (per Morris 1943 label)
ON-036.note: Polygon overlaps earlier surrenders (Johnson-Butler, Collins, Rice Lake, Robinson-Huron) that the 1923 treaties re-covered

ON-037.comment: Morris label date (May 30th, 1929) is cited with order in council P.C. 921, not an adhesion signing; not used

CA-GP0009b.comment: 1779 is the end of the range in the dataset name 'Peace and Friendship Treaties (1725-1779)', not from a page
CA-GP0009b.signatories: Penobscot, Norridgewock and St. John's Indians (1725 Boston articles, ratified June 1726 by 'all the Nova Scotia Tribes' at Annapolis Royal); Jean Baptiste Cope (1752); LaHave Tribe and others (1760-61)
CA-GP0009b.note: Peace and Friendship Treaties did not cede land; CIRNAC draws an area for them. Dates: Boston articles 1725 and Annapolis Royal ratification June 1726 (recited in the 1752 text), Halifax 22 Nov 1752, LaHave March 1760; 1779 from the dataset name range only

CA-GP0010a.signatories: Slave, Dogrib, Loucheux, Hare and other Indians

CA-HT03.drop: Southern Ontario Treaties (1764-1862) aggregate; replaced by 33 individual Ontario LIO polygons

CA-HT06.signatories: Teechamitsa, Kosampsom, Swengwhung, Chilcowitch, Whyomilth, Che-ko-nein, Ka-ky-aakan, Chewhaytsum, Sooke, Saanich (South), Saanich (North), Queackar, Quakeolth, Saalequun (tribe/family names as written in the conveyances to the Hudson's Bay Company)
CA-HT06.note: 14 Douglas conveyances on Vancouver Island merged into one multipolygon by CIRNAC; Saalequun (Nanaimo) date from CIRNAC bracket [December 23, 1854]

CA-HT07.signatories: Chippewa and Swampy Cree Tribes of Indians
CA-HT07.note: 1875 dates are the signed amendments ('outside promises') to Treaties 1 and 2

CA-HT09.signatories: Saulteaux Tribe of the Ojibbeway Indians (adhesions: Halfbreeds of Rainy River and Lake; Lac Seul Indians)

CA-HT13.signatories: Blackfeet, Blood, Piegan, Sarcee, Stony and other Indians

CA-HT14.signatories: Cree, Beaver, Chipewyan and other Indians (1900 adhesions incl. Beavers of Fort St. John, Slaves of Upper Hay River, Dogribs of Great Slave Lake)

CA-HT16.signatories: Chipewyan, Cree and other Indian inhabitants

CA-PT0011a.signatories: Saulteaux and Swampy Cree Tribes of Indians (adhesions 1908-10: Split Lake, Nelson House, Norway House, Cross Lake, Fisher River, Oxford House, Deer Lake, Fort Churchill, York Factory bands)
CA-PT0011a.note: Polygon includes the 1908-10 adhesion area (to 60 N)

CA-PT0012a.signatories: Plain and Wood Cree and other Tribes of Indians (adhesions incl. Stony Indians)

CA-PT0015a.drop: Treaty 9 incl. 1929-30 adhesion as one polygon; LIO 035 + 037 used

merges.why: Treaty 45 (1836) and Treaty 94 (1862) carry identical geometry in the Ontario layer
merges.name: Manitoulin Island Treaties (No. 45, 1836; No. 94, 1862)
merges.signatories: Chippewas and Ottawas 'for all Indians to reside thereon' (Morris, No. 45); Ottawa, Chippewa and other Indians (CIRNAC text, No. 94)
